summary: Overall kitchen is tidy, but loose floor matting poses a tripping risk.

hazards.title: Loose runner rug on floor
hazards.detail: Runner lacks visible non-slip backing or taped edges and can slide easily.
fixSteps: Place a non-slip rug pad underneath the entire area of the rug.
Secure curled edges with double-sided floor rug tape.

products.reason: Prevents kitchen rugs from slipping and sliding on hard flooring.
